home.heroSubtitle: One SDK. Any framework. Zero config. Add secure authentication to your application in minutes, not weeks.
home.featuresSectionSubtitle: Enterprise-grade authentication with a developer-first approach. Built for modern applications.
home.featureSsoDesc: One account across all your applications. Users authenticate once and access everything seamlessly.
home.featureApiKeysDesc: Generate, manage, and monitor API keys with built-in usage tracking and quota management.
home.featureOauthDesc: Google OAuth built in, with more providers coming soon. Let users sign in with accounts they already have.
home.feature2faDesc: TOTP-based 2FA with backup codes. Add an extra layer of security to any user account.
home.featureRbacDesc: Fine-grained permissions with superadmin, admin, and user roles. Scope access per application.
home.featureSecurityDesc: Session management, audit logging, rate limiting, token rotation, and encrypted storage by default.
home.howItWorksStep1Desc: Add the EZAuth SDK to your project with a single command.
home.howItWorksStep2Desc: Wrap your app with AuthProvider. Configuration is automatic.
home.howItWorksStep3Desc: Access user data, roles, and auth state with simple React hooks.
home.codeSectionSubtitle: From installation to protected routes in under 5 minutes.
home.pricingSectionSubtitle: Start free, scale as you grow. No hidden fees.
home.ctaSubtitle: Add authentication to your app in minutes. Free forever for small projects.
